introduction: Illinois WIC provides selected food benefits, nutrition support and breastfeeding help. Start by arranging an appointment with a local WIC office.
description: Illinois WIC provides selected food benefits, nutrition support and breastfeeding help. Start by arranging an appointment with a local WIC office.

sections.who: WIC serves eligible pregnant and recently postpartum women, infants and children younger than five, including foster children. A clinic checks the applicable income and other certification conditions.
sections.get: Participants use WIC EBT for their prescribed foods. Nutrition counseling and referrals support the needs of the enrolled family members.
sections.docs:
• Ask the clinic for the records needed for certification.
  • Prepare identification, residence and household income or benefit records.
  • Confirm who must attend the appointment.
sections.apply:
1. Find the clinic

    Use the DHS Office Locator linked from the state WIC page.

  2. Book certification

    Ask which documents and applicants to bring.

  3. Complete the assessment

    Clinic staff determine eligibility and explain benefits and shopping instructions.
sections.after: Use your local clinic for benefit or appointment questions. The main state WIC page lists 844-901-0962 for additional assistance.
sections.sources: Reviewed October 1, 2026 using WIC application and contacts, applicant categories and current guidelines. Agency staff determine eligibility.
